entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, my order number is VF88602. This VeloBand Pulse you sent me is a piece of garbage.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. I've pulled up your order. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault! The pulse reading is completely wrong. It's dangerous. I don't have time to play games with you people. I just want my money back.
I understand your frustration. We can definitely look into a replacement or see if some troubleshooting might resolve the sensor issue...

No! I'm not troubleshooting anything. The product is garbage. I want a refund, not another broken device. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager and light up your social media pages?
I understand you're not interested in troubleshooting. That's perfectly fine. Let me just review your purchase date and our return policy. Please hold for one moment.
Thank you for waiting. Okay, I see here that your VeloBand was delivered 28 days ago. According to our policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window for a full refund.
So you're actually going to give me the refund? No more hassle?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Fine. Make sure that email comes through immediately.
The email has just been sent. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
